newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Ayala Land in joint venture with Siam Cement, Redland.
newsitem.headline: Ayala Land in joint venture with Siam Cement, Redland.

text.p: Ayala Land Inc said on Wednesday it had formed a joint venture with Redland PLC and Siam Cement Public Company Limited to manufacture high-quality rooftiles for the Philippine market.
The new joint venture, called CPAC MONIER Philippines Inc, will start construction of its plant in mid-1997 at a seven-hectare site in Batangas city, south of Manila.
It will have the capacity to produce 15 million rooftiles a year and will be operational in mid-1998.
The company did not reveal the project cost and the equity sharing between the investors.
Ayala Land said its venture into rooftile manufacturing is in line with its thrust to form strategic alliances and expand its base of operations in the real estate business.
"This investment answers the growing national need for reasonably priced high quality concrete rooftiles for its middle-income residential developments," Ayala Land said.
Siam Cement and Redland will provide technology in the joint venture.

British company Redland is the world's largest manufacturer of rooftiles, while Siam Cement is Thailand's biggest manufacturer of construction materials and dominates more than half of its domestic cement market.
